title: Lock topics
notes: Moderators can now lock a topic to stop new replies — lock/unlock from the topic's “⋯” menu. Locked topics show a badge and a notice in place of the reply box. Gated by the “Lock / unlock topics” permission.

changelog.text: Lock topics: moderators can lock a discussion to stop new replies (topic “⋯” menu), gated by the “Lock / unlock topics” permission.
